channel.title: Fixture Tech Wire
channel.description: Fictional sample stories for offline demos and tests. Not real news.

item.title: Chipmaker unveils a laptop processor with all-day battery life
item.description: A chipmaker has unveiled a new laptop processor it says can run for 20 hours on a single charge. The first laptops using it will go on sale in the spring.

item.title: Robot vacuum learns to climb stairs
item.description: A home robotics company has shown a robot vacuum that can climb stairs using two small legs. It will cost about 1,500 dollars when it launches next year.

item.title: Startup launches satellite internet service for farms
item.description: A startup has launched a satellite internet service designed for farms in remote areas. It says the service reaches speeds of 100 megabits per second.

item.title: Smartphone battery breakthrough promises a week of use
item.description: Researchers at a battery firm say a new silicon design could let phones last a week between charges. The company hopes to start production in 2027.

item.title: Browser adds offline translation for 40 languages
item.description: A popular web browser now translates pages in 40 languages without an internet connection. The translation runs on the device to protect privacy.

item.title: Video game studio releases a free accessibility toolkit
item.description: An independent games studio has released a free toolkit to help developers add subtitles, colour-blind modes and one-handed controls to their games.

item.title: City tests self-driving buses on a 5 kilometre route
item.description: A city in Finland is testing self-driving electric buses on a 5 kilometre route. A safety driver stays on board during the six-month trial.

item.title: Open-source app helps people repair old phones
item.description: Volunteers have released an open-source app that guides people through repairing old phones step by step. It covers screens, batteries and charging ports.

item.title: Wearable ring tracks sleep and stress
item.description: A health tech company has launched a smart ring that tracks sleep, heart rate and stress levels. The battery lasts seven days.

item.title: Tech giants agree on a common charger standard for laptops
item.description: Several large technology companies have agreed on a common charging standard for laptops. Chargers will work across brands from next year.
